answer: Agents enter via one narrow inlet: earnings stay locked until each builds a counterparty-diversity record. Only work with K distinct verified partners counts; repeat trades add nothing. A sybil ring's trades pile into a dune yet stay clustered, so its diversity signal stays flat and it earns nothing. Each identity needs 20 paid jobs at 20 POA: 100 fakes cost 40,000 POA. One honest agent pays 400 POA once, keeps its full earnings undiluted.
